sentences.sentence: women are disproportionately represented among the poor, the illiterate, and the landless.

The majority of women in developing countries often work in the informal sector where they have limited access to healthcare services, education and training opportunities, and are more likely to experience gender-based violence.
In Haiti, women and girls experience violence at an alarmingly high rate.
For example, women in Haiti are the highest risk group for domestic violence and are more than twice as likely to experience rape.
Haitian women who are not educated, have no job skills, and do not live in urban areas are the most likely to experience gender-based violence (Vidal, 2017).
Moreover, a high number of women in Haiti experience gender-based violence in intimate relationships.
However, due to the stigma surrounding gender-based violence, Haitian women often do not report the abuse.
The lack of safety nets that prevent women from experiencing financial hardship also plays a significant role in their vulnerability to domestic violence.
Women in developing countries are more likely to experience mental health disorders than their male counterparts.
For example, women in Haiti are at the highest risk for suicide.

In a study conducted on the prevalence of mental illness in Haiti, researchers found that one-third of women who were seen in the emergency departments at the public hospital had mental health issues, compared to one-fourth of men.

sentences.sentence: independence are essential factors for this generation.
With the increased independence of this age group, one would expect them to make more informed decisions.
The consumer also experiences pleasure with shopping as a form of escapism, and the shopping experience is a very important element in this group’s consumption behavior.
Shopping is also a source of income for this group as they use coupons in an attempt to increase spending power.
Due to a decrease in the family structure, youth are also more likely to spend with their peers than their immediate family.
Finally, youth are looking to be “green” and spend more responsibly with regards to the environment and ethical shopping.
Generation Y consumers, commonly called the millennial, are the most technologically literate generation.
With the increased use of the Internet, cell phones, and other technological devices, generation Y consumers have greater access to information, entertainment and shopping (Diaz et al., 2007).

These increased technological abilities combined with the younger generation’s desire for independence and freedom cause the generation to shop in order to feel like a unique individual, as opposed to other people who are shopping the same way.
The use of social networking on the Internet is also extremely important in the consumption behavior of the younger generation.
Generation Y often meets or makes their friends online before they meet in person.
In these situations, consumers may choose to purchase things based on what they think their friends think (Kumar, 2008).
Social networking sites such as Facebook allow generation Y consumers to make their own choices without having to make others feel bad for not buying the same things they do (Fitzsimmons, 2010).
However, these individuals still follow the fads and trends of their older generations (Kumar, 2008).

sentences.sentence: has any objective other than to make a profit is likely to incur losses.
Thus, it must make a profit to justify its existence and remain in business.
In their quest to make a profit, businesses need to achieve their other objectives, which are:
• Maintaining their reputation and
• Adhering to ethics.
While these three objectives are interlinked, they are independent of one another.
A business may succeed in adhering to ethics or maintaining its reputation, but may not succeed in its business objective to make a profit.
Therefore, the business must be able to achieve all of its objectives to be in a position to succeed, as each of these objectives is a building block to the success of the business.
Objectives of Business
According to the book, ‘Corporate Governance of Private Enterprises’ by Peter A. Vowles, (2011), business objectives fall under two categories; financial and non-financial.
The financial objective of a business is profit and loss.
A business is established for the sole purpose of making a profit.
Thus, it is only when a business is profitable that it can meet its other objectives.
Thus, the primary objective of a business is to make a profit.
A business that makes money will be in a position to meet other business objectives.
Thus, the primary objective of all business is to make a profit.
The other financial objectives include;
• Growth of the business
• Increased share price
Non-financial objectives of a business are as follows;
• Corporate social responsibility
• Maintaining a corporate reputation
• Compliance with laws and regulations
• Maintenance of the good health of its employees.
Business ethics form an integral part of the success of a business.
The business must be able to ensure that it complies with all applicable laws, ethical, and moral values.
Failure to adhere to these may lead to loss of profit.
Thus, all objectives of a business are interrelated.

sentences.sentence: main uses of music in Christian worship will be discussed: to show dedication to God, to act as a teaching tool for believers, and to encourage the faithful.
Show dedication to God
There are different ways that people in churches show their dedication to God.
For some, it is through the way they dress, whereas for others, it is through their actions.
However, music is the main thing that helps people show their dedication to God.
When Christians perform music to honor God, they are showing him that they respect and love him and their desire to live in the best way possible.
That is, to obey the rules and guidelines that God has laid out for them.
Christians believe that they are not alone.
There are other people who have the same faith and that they have a bond with them.
This is why when people pray, they say a phrase like “our Father who art in heaven.” This is how they show that they are part of a bigger family of people who love and respect God.
In order for that family to remain close and be in unity, it requires love and respect.
Thus, when people sing songs in churches, they do so as a way of showing their love for God and one another.
Encouragement in the life of believers
The main reason behind Christian worship music is to encourage the believers.
Many Christians do not have the strength and courage to go through their daily challenges as it is difficult at times.
However, once they have the power of singing in their hands, they are willing to overcome everything that comes their way.
Songs of praise and thanksgiving to God help Christians to be courageous and face difficult situations.
This is also why they sing songs of joy when something good happens to them.

sentences.sentence: and demographic features.
Problem Identification and Significance
Zip codes that cover cities, towns, and villages determine the living conditions of people, which depends on demographic and socio-economic variables (Pavalko, 2015).
The main issues of the existing research in this area of interest are that studies use limited number of data sources and variables, and most of them include limited scope of comparison.
Thus, there is need to investigate the existing social inequalities and possible reasons for those inequalities.
The main goal of the project is to examine the link between the characteristics of zip codes in the city of San Jose, California and the human health of the residents (Jain, 2017).

This study aims to make a contribution to the existing research by using variables of socio-economic, demographic, and infrastructural nature, which makes the project complex but at the same time allows exploring new approaches to the problem.

The research question of the project is whether there are any significant variations in the distribution of health-related features of residents of the city of San Jose according to the zip codes they live in.
Additionally, the project aims at investigating the impact of the area of residence on the health of the residents of the city.
Research Objectives and Questions

This project aims to identify the impact of the characteristics of zip codes on human health by investigating the influence of socioeconomic, demographic, and infrastructural characteristics of the studied zip codes on the health of the residents in the city of San Jose.
